name: Token Terminal
description:
Token Terminal MCP brings institutional-grade blockchain data into Claude.

Query standardized on-chain financial and usage metrics across 100+ blockchains, 1,200+ applications, and 3,000+ tokenized assets - using natural language.

The MCP connects Claude directly to Token Terminal’s data layer, which transforms raw blockchain activity into clean and comparable metrics.

Built for investors, analysts, developers, and researchers who want reliable blockchain data in a clean and standardized format.

A Token Terminal account is required. A free tier is available.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Token Terminal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Token Terminal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tokenterminal.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Token Terminal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Token Terminal provides these MCP tools: research.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Token Terminal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Token Terminal in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Token Terminal MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Token Terminal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Token Terminal is developed by Token Terminal Oy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
